# ListItemText

Text for list item

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: ListItemText

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { ListItemText } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<ListItemText 
  primary="Primary Text" 
  secondary="Secondary text"
/>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<ListItemText 
  primary="Primary Text" 
  secondary="Secondary text"
/>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's ListItemText.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI ListItemText Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/listitemtext/)
